overview.description: The UBS AG ETRACS Crude Oil Shares Covered Call ETNs due April 24, 2037 (USOI) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in crude oil commodities. The fund offers the returns of a covered call strategy on a front-month oil futures ETF. USOI was launched on Apr 25, 2017 and is issued by ETRACS.
